study.brief_title: Efficacy and Safety of Drug X in Patients with Hypertension
study.official_title: A Phase 3, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Parallel-Group Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Drug X 10mg Once Daily in Adult Patients with Essential Hypertension

interventions.name: Drug X
interventions.description: Drug X 10mg oral tablet administered once daily for 12 weeks

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: Matching placebo tablet administered once daily for 12 weeks

outcomes.title: Change in Sitting Systolic Blood Pressure from Baseline to Week 12
outcomes.description: Mean change in sitting systolic blood pressure (SBP) measured by automatic sphygmomanometer

outcomes.title: Change in Sitting Diastolic Blood Pressure
outcomes.description: Mean change in sitting diastolic blood pressure (DBP)

outcomes.title: Proportion of Responders
outcomes.description: Proportion of patients achieving SBP < 140 mmHg and DBP < 90 mmHg
